text.text: Keep the deal, what you owe and what you are owed together. Follow-up dates and due dates sit on calendars so nothing is missed.
A pitch is one screen of text. If it needs scrolling, the brand will not reach the ask.
One line on who you reach
One result from a past partnership
Who you reach: give the audience in plain numbers and describe who they are.
A past result: one number from a past partnership, with the brand named if allowed.
The idea: show the content you would make for this brand, not content in general.
Rates and timeline: give a fee and the dates it would run.
The ask: one question they can answer yes or no.
Most late payments come from a missing detail in the first invoice, not from a bad client. The checklist closes those gaps.
Invoice sent the day content goes live
Reminder set for the due date
Late payment note sent after seven days
Mark the deal Closed when funds arrive
Note the date of every reminder in the payment row. If you need to escalate, a dated list of what you sent and when is what a brand’s accounts team will ask for.
